---
title: "catTFRE real-data — sample correlation and NE → C4 → C1 shift"
author: "XuanThangNguyen"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

# Goal
Spectral counts are normalized as `log2(count + 1)` for the correlation
analysis. Bins for the alluvial are computed on the **raw** mean count per
protein × cell line × condition (across the four replicates):

| Bin     | Mean raw count (per condition)   |
|---------|----------------------------------|
| Na      | < 1   (essentially undetected)   |
| Low     | 1 – 19                           |
| Med     | 20 - 50                          |
| High    | ≥ 50                             |

# Setup

```{r setup_env, include=FALSE}
root_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_dir("catTFRE_MS_FinalRound"))
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "catTFRE_MS_FinalRound")
plots_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "catTFRE_corelation")
# Create plots_dir if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(plots_dir)) {dir.create(plots_dir, recursive = TRUE)}

require_packages <- c("readxl","dplyr","tidyr","tibble","stringr","purrr","ggplot2","patchwork","scales","openxlsx","ggalluvial")
to_install <- setdiff(require_packages, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(to_install))
  install.packages(to_install, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
invisible(lapply(require_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
          theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")))

CELL_LINES <- c("MG63","U2OS","HOS")
CONDITIONS <- c("NE","C4","C1")
REPS       <- 1:4
BIN_LAB    <- c("Na","Low","Med","High")
```

# Load data
```{r load}
# Load the background data, keep at least 50% of data that appear in CRAPome
U2OS_CRAPome <- read.xlsx(file.path(analysis_dir,"CrapDB_U2OS_StrepHA.xlsx"), rowNames = T)
U2OS_CRAPome <- U2OS_CRAPome %>% dplyr::filter(NUM_EXPT > 1.5 & AVE_SC > 3) # 3 U2OS samples

# Load the raw count
counts_raw <- read_excel(file.path(analysis_dir,"catTFRE_Round4_HOS_MG63_U2OS_Thang.xlsx"), sheet = 1)
# Extract the sample column
sample_cols <- grep("^(HOS|MG63|U2OS)_(C1|C4|NE)_rep[1-4]$", colnames(counts_raw), value = TRUE)
stopifnot("Need exactly 36 sample columns" = length(sample_cols) == 36)

sample_cols <- grep("^(HOS|MG63|U2OS)_(C1|C4|NE)_rep[1-4]$",
                    colnames(counts_raw),
                    value = TRUE)
# Keep rows with at least 1 non-zero values and remove the back ground
counts_raw <- counts_raw[rowSums(counts_raw[, sample_cols] != 0) >= 1,] %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!Gene_Symbol %in% rownames(U2OS_CRAPome))

design_path <- file.path(analysis_dir, "catTFRE_CiiDER.xlsx")
# Designed TF list from sheet catTFRE_design of the CiiDER workbook
if (file.exists(design_path)) {
  catTFRE_design <- read_excel(design_path, sheet = "S1A", skip = 1) %>%
    rename_with(~ str_trim(.x)) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.character), str_trim))
} else {
  warning("Design file not found at ", design_path,
          " — Designed flag will be all FALSE.")
  catTFRE_design <- tibble(TF = character(0))
}

split_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_replace_all("\\(.*?\\)", "") %>%
    str_replace_all("-\\d+(?=(::|--|-)|-?$)", "") %>%   # strip isoform numbers
    str_split("::|--|-") %>%
    map(~ toupper(str_trim(.x))) %>%
    map(~ .x[grepl("^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,}$", .x)])        # must look like a gene symbol
}

designed_TFs <- if (nrow(catTFRE_design) > 0)
  unique(unlist(split_name(catTFRE_design$TF))) else character(0)

designed_flag <- counts_raw %>%
  transmute(Accession,
            Gene_Symbol_up = toupper(str_trim(Gene_Symbol)),
            Designed       = Gene_Symbol_up %in% designed_TFs)

# Load the TF list database
tf_list_path <- file.path(analysis_dir, "TFs_list_Cell2018.xlsx")
# ---- TF database (curated list) -------------------------------------------
if (file.exists(tf_list_path)) {
  tf_db <- read_excel(tf_list_path, sheet = 1)
  g  <- toupper(str_trim(as.character(tf_db$Name)))
  u  <- str_trim(as.character(tf_db$Protein_Uniprot))
  tf_genes_db   <- unique(g[!is.na(g) & nzchar(g) & g != "NA"])
  tf_uniprot_db <- unique(u[!is.na(u) & nzchar(u) & u != "NA"])
} else {
  warning("TF list not found at ", tf_list_path,
          " — IsTF flag will be all FALSE.")
  tf_genes_db <- character(0); tf_uniprot_db <- character(0)
}

# Add column of TFs
tf_flag <- counts_raw %>%
  transmute(Accession,
            Gene_Symbol_up      = toupper(str_trim(Gene_Symbol)),
            Protein_Uniprot_str = str_trim(as.character(Protein_Uniprot)),
            IsTF = (Gene_Symbol_up %in% tf_genes_db) |
                   (Protein_Uniprot_str %in% tf_uniprot_db))
# Show an overview of what inside the data
cat(sprintf("Proteins: %d | Sample cols: %d | Designed TFs detectable: %d | TFs (DB) detectable: %d\n",
            nrow(counts_raw), length(sample_cols),
            sum(designed_flag$Designed),
            sum(tf_flag$IsTF)))
```


```{r} 
# Set the color and threshold that we can detected
COND_COLOURS <- c(NE = "#377EB8", C4 = "#1B9E77", C1 = "#A020F0") #1B9E77 #D73027 #377EB8 # 2CA25F
DET_THR      <- 1   # raw count threshold for "detected" (≥ DET_THR)

# Prepare for the count (select the one detected in at least 1 rep)
count_detected <- function(accessions = NULL) {
  d <- counts_raw %>%
    dplyr::select(Accession, all_of(sample_cols))
  if (!is.null(accessions))
    d <- d %>% filter(Accession %in% accessions)

  d %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(sample_cols),
                 names_to = "sample", values_to = "count") %>%
    separate(sample, c("cell_line","condition","rep"),
             sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(rep        = as.integer(str_remove(rep, "rep")),
           cell_line  = factor(cell_line, levels = CELL_LINES),
           condition  = factor(condition, levels = CONDITIONS)) %>%
    group_by(cell_line, condition, rep) %>%
    summarise(n_detected = sum(count >= DET_THR), .groups = "drop")
}

# Count the detect protein
det_all <- count_detected() # all proteins
det_tf  <- count_detected(tf_flag %>% filter(IsTF) %>% pull(Accession))

# Plot the counts
plot_overview <- function(d, title) {
  smy <- d %>%
    group_by(cell_line, condition) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(n_detected),
              sd   = sd(n_detected), .groups = "drop") 
  # Order cell lines
  smy$cell_line <- factor(smy$cell_line,levels = c("MG63", "U2OS", "HOS"))
  d$cell_line <- factor(d$cell_line,levels = c("MG63", "U2OS", "HOS"))
  # Plot
  ggplot(smy, aes(cell_line, mean, color = condition)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.78),width = 0.72,fill = "white",linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd,ymax = mean + sd),position = position_dodge(0.78),width = 0.18,linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(data = d,
                aes(y = n_detected,group = condition,color = condition),
                position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12,dodge.width = 0.78,seed = 1),
                size = 1.8,alpha = 0.9,inherit.aes = TRUE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(mean, 0),y = mean + sd + max(smy$mean) * 0.1),position = position_dodge(0.78),size = 2.6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = COND_COLOURS,name = "Condition") +
    labs(title = title,x = NULL,y = sprintf("# detected proteins (count ≥ %d)", DET_THR)) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
          legend.position = "right")
}

# Count the dat with all protein and TF only
p_all <- plot_overview(det_all,
  sprintf("All proteins (n = %s)", format(nrow(counts_raw), big.mark = ",")))
p_tf  <- plot_overview(det_tf,
  sprintf("TFs only (n = %d)", sum(tf_flag$IsTF)))

overview_grid <- (p_all | p_tf) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
overview_grid

ggsave(file.path(plots_dir, "OS_catTFRE_overview_detected.pdf"), overview_grid, width = 6, height = 5)

# Also save individual plots in case you want them standalone
ggsave(file.path(plots_dir, "OS_catTFRE_overview_detected_all.pdf"), p_all, width = 3, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(plots_dir, "OS_catTFRE_overview_detected_TFs.pdf"), p_tf,  width = 3, height = 5)
```


```{r}
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)

# Function to compute pairwise stats + get plotting coordinates
get_stats <- function(d, dodge_width = 0.78) {
  d %>%
    group_by(cell_line) %>%
    pairwise_t_test(n_detected ~ condition,
                    p.adjust.method = "BH") %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "cell_line", dodge = dodge_width, step.increase = 0.08)
}

stats_all <- get_stats(det_all)
stats_tf  <- get_stats(det_tf)

# Updated plot_overview to accept and overlay stats
plot_overview <- function(d, title, stats_df, show_ns = FALSE) {
  smy <- d %>%
    group_by(cell_line, condition) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(n_detected),
              sd   = sd(n_detected), .groups = "drop")

  smy$cell_line <- factor(smy$cell_line, levels = c("MG63", "U2OS", "HOS"))
  d$cell_line   <- factor(d$cell_line,   levels = c("MG63", "U2OS", "HOS"))

  # rstatix's add_xy_position() encodes x as numeric cell_line positions;
  # re-map to match the same factor level order used in the plot
  stats_df <- stats_df %>%
    mutate(cell_line = factor(cell_line, levels = c("MG63", "U2OS", "HOS")))

  if (!show_ns) stats_df <- stats_df %>% filter(p.adj < 0.05)

  p <- ggplot(smy, aes(cell_line, mean, color = condition)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.78), width = 0.72,
             fill = "white", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
                  position = position_dodge(0.78), width = 0.18, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(data = d,
                aes(y = n_detected, group = condition, color = condition),
                position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.12,
                                                 dodge.width = 0.78, seed = 1),
                size = 1.8, alpha = 0.9, inherit.aes = TRUE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(mean, 0),
                  y = mean + sd + max(smy$mean) * 0.1),
              position = position_dodge(0.78), size = 2.6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = COND_COLOURS, name = "Condition") +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL,
         y = sprintf("# detected proteins (count ≥ %d)", DET_THR)) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
          legend.position = "right")

  if (nrow(stats_df) > 0) {
    p <- p + stat_pvalue_manual(
      stats_df,
      label = "p.adj.signif",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      size = 3,
      coord.flip = TRUE   # tells ggpubr the plot is flipped
    )
  }
  p
}

p_all <- plot_overview(det_all,
  sprintf("All proteins (n = %s)", format(nrow(counts_raw), big.mark = ",")),
  stats_all)
p_tf  <- plot_overview(det_tf,
  sprintf("TFs only (n = %d)", sum(tf_flag$IsTF)),
  stats_tf)

overview_grid <- (p_all | p_tf) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")
overview_grid

ggsave(file.path(plots_dir, "OS_catTFRE_overview_detected_statistic.pdf"), overview_grid, width = 7, height = 5)
```


```{r}
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)

wb <- createWorkbook()

# ============================================================
# Helper function
# ============================================================
make_protein_sheet <- function(df, sample_cols, sheet_name){
  protein_lists <- lapply(sample_cols, function(samp){
    df %>%
      filter(.data[[samp]] >= DET_THR) %>%
      transmute(Protein = paste0(Gene_Symbol, " | ", Accession)) %>%
      pull(Protein) %>%
      sort()
  })

  names(protein_lists) <- sample_cols
  max_len <- max(lengths(protein_lists))
  protein_df <- as.data.frame(
    lapply(protein_lists, function(x){
      c(length(x), x, rep(NA, max_len - length(x)))}), 
    check.names = FALSE)
  rownames(protein_df) <- c("N_proteins", seq_len(max_len))
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, protein_df, rowNames = TRUE)
}

# ============================================================
# Sheet 1: Counts only
# ============================================================
summary_counts <- bind_rows(
  lapply(sample_cols, function(samp){
    data.frame(Sample = samp,
               N_proteins = counts_raw %>%
        filter(.data[[samp]] >= DET_THR) %>%
        nrow())
  })
)

addWorksheet(wb, "AllProtein_Counts")
writeData(wb, "AllProtein_Counts", summary_counts)

# ============================================================
# Sheet 2: All proteins
# ============================================================
make_protein_sheet(df = counts_raw,
                   sample_cols = sample_cols,
                   sheet_name = "AllProtein_Lists")

# ============================================================
# Sheet 3: TF proteins only
# ============================================================
tf_accessions <- tf_flag %>%
  filter(IsTF) %>%
  pull(Accession)

counts_tf <- counts_raw %>%
  filter(Accession %in% tf_accessions)
# Write the sheet
make_protein_sheet(df = counts_tf,
                   sample_cols = sample_cols,
                   sheet_name = "TF_Lists")

# ============================================================
# Save
# ============================================================
saveWorkbook(wb,file.path(plots_dir,"OS_catTFRE_ProteinLists_PerReplicate.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Per (cell, condition) TF detection at the GENE-SYMBOL level (not per-rep counts)
tf_long_mean <- counts_raw %>%
  inner_join(tf_flag %>% filter(IsTF) %>% select(Accession), by = "Accession") %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(sample_cols), names_to = "sample", values_to = "count") %>%
  separate(sample, c("cell_line","condition","rep"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(rep = as.integer(str_remove(rep, "rep"))) %>%
  group_by(Accession, Gene_Symbol, cell_line, condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_count = mean(count), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(detected = mean_count >= DET_THR,
         gs = toupper(str_trim(Gene_Symbol)))

library(UpSetR)
library(grid)

SET_ORDER <- c("HOS_C1","MG63_C1","U2OS_C1",
               "HOS_C4","MG63_C4","U2OS_C4",
               "HOS_NE","MG63_NE","U2OS_NE")

COND_COLOURS <- c(C1 = "#A020F0",
                  C4 = "#1B9E77",
                  NE = "#377EB8")

library(ComplexUpset)

# For each cell line, build a binary detected/not matrix
make_upset_data <- function(cl) {
  tf_long_mean %>%
    filter(cell_line == cl) %>%
    select(Accession, condition, detected) %>%
    mutate(detected = as.integer(detected)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = detected, values_fill = 0)
}

# Plot per cell line
for (cl in c("HOS", "MG63", "U2OS")) {
  d <- make_upset_data(cl)
  p <- upset(d, intersect = c("NE", "C4", "C1"),
             name = paste0(cl, " – Detected TFs"),
             width_ratio = 0.3,
             set_sizes = FALSE)
  ggsave(paste0("upset_", cl, ".pdf"), p, width = 6, height = 4)
}
```

```{r}
##=============================================================================
## Single UpSet plot – All 9 groups (cell line × condition) as sets
## Shows overlap of detectable protein and TFs across all cell lines and conditions
##=============================================================================
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexUpset)

MIN_REPS <- 1   # detected in at least 1 of 4 reps
# ── Build binary matrix: one column per cell_line × condition ────────────────
tf_accessions <- tf_flag %>% filter(IsTF) %>% pull(Accession)

upset_all_tf <- counts_raw %>%
  filter(Accession %in% tf_accessions) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(sample_cols),
               names_to = "sample", values_to = "count") %>%
  separate(sample, c("cell_line", "condition", "rep"), sep = "_") %>%
  group_by(Accession, cell_line, condition) %>%
  summarise(n_reps_detected = sum(count >= DET_THR), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(group    = paste0(cell_line, "_", condition),
         detected = as.integer(n_reps_detected >= MIN_REPS)) %>%
  select(Accession, group, detected) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = detected, values_fill = 0L)

# Define set order: grouped by cell line
sets_ordered <- c("HOS_NE",  "HOS_C4",  "HOS_C1", 
                  "MG63_NE", "MG63_C4", "MG63_C1",
                  "U2OS_NE", "U2OS_C4", "U2OS_C1")

# ── Colour mapping ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
group_colours <- c(HOS_NE  = "#377EB8", HOS_C4  = "#1B9E77", HOS_C1  = "#A020F0",
                   MG63_NE = "#377EB8", MG63_C4 = "#1B9E77", MG63_C1 = "#A020F0",
                   U2OS_NE = "#377EB8", U2OS_C4 = "#1B9E77", U2OS_C1 = "#A020F0")
# ── Plot TFs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p <- upset(upset_all_tf,
           intersect      = sets_ordered,
           name           = "Cell line × Condition",
           width_ratio    = 0.20,
           min_size       = 1,
           n_intersections = 20,
           sort_sets      = FALSE,
           sort_intersections_by = "cardinality",
           set_sizes = (upset_set_size() +
                          scale_fill_manual(values = group_colours, guide = "none")),
           base_annotations = list("Intersection size" = (intersection_size(bar_number_threshold = 1,text = list(size = 2.5)) +
                                                            scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
                                                            coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 25)) +
                                                            scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))))),
           matrix = (intersection_matrix(geom    = geom_point(size = 2.5),
                                         segment = geom_segment(linewidth = 0.6)) + 
                       scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "grey85"),guide = "none")),
           stripes = "white",
           themes = upset_modify_themes(list(overall_sizes = theme(
             axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
             axis.title.x = element_blank()),
             intersections_matrix = theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"))))) +
  ggtitle("Detectable TFs across all cell lines and chromatin fractions") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13))

# ggsave the plot
ggsave(file.path(plots_dir, "catTFRE_upset_all_groups_TFs.pdf"), p, width = 10, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)

# ── Same for ALL proteins ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Replace mean-based detection with replicate-counting

upset_all_prot <- counts_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(sample_cols),
               names_to = "sample", values_to = "count") %>%
  separate(sample, c("cell_line", "condition", "rep"), sep = "_") %>%
  group_by(Accession, cell_line, condition) %>%
  summarise(n_reps_detected = sum(count >= DET_THR), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(group    = paste0(cell_line, "_", condition),
         detected = as.integer(n_reps_detected >= MIN_REPS)) %>%
  select(Accession, group, detected) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = detected, values_fill = 0L)

p2 <- upset(upset_all_prot,
            intersect      = sets_ordered,
            name           = "Cell line × Condition",
            width_ratio    = 0.20,
            min_size       = 1,
            n_intersections = 20,
            sort_sets      = FALSE,
            sort_intersections_by = "cardinality",
            set_sizes = (upset_set_size() +
                           scale_fill_manual(values = group_colours, guide = "none")),
            base_annotations = list("Intersection size" = (intersection_size(bar_number_threshold = 1,text = list(size = 2.5)) +
                                                            scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
                                                            coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 500)) +
                                                            scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))))),
            matrix = (intersection_matrix(geom    = geom_point(size = 2.5),
                                         segment = geom_segment(linewidth = 0.6)) + 
                       scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "grey85"),guide = "none")),
            stripes = "white",
            themes = upset_modify_themes(list(overall_sizes = theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
                                                                    axis.title.x = element_blank()),
                                              intersections_matrix = theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"))))) +
  ggtitle("Detectable proteins across all cell lines and chromatin fractions") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13))
# Save the plot as pdf
ggsave(file.path(plots_dir, "catTFRE_upset_all_groups_allProteins.pdf"), p2, width = 10, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)

message("✓ Saved: upset_all_groups_TFs.pdf, upset_all_groups_allProteins.pdf")
```

```{r}
EXAMPLE_GENES <- c("RUNX2","PITX1","FOXO1","MYBL2", "FOXC2", "NR2F2", "CTCF", "CEBPB")

example_long <- counts_raw %>%
  filter(toupper(str_trim(Gene_Symbol)) %in% toupper(EXAMPLE_GENES)) %>%
  select(Accession, Gene_Symbol, all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(sample_cols),
               names_to = "sample", values_to = "count") %>%
  separate(sample, c("cell_line","condition","rep"),
           sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(rep        = as.integer(str_remove(rep, "rep")),
         cell_line  = factor(cell_line,  levels = CELL_LINES),
         condition  = factor(condition,  levels = CONDITIONS),
         Gene_Symbol = factor(Gene_Symbol, levels = EXAMPLE_GENES))

# Sanity: which genes were found?
example_long %>% distinct(Gene_Symbol) %>% pull(Gene_Symbol)

example_summary <- example_long %>%
  group_by(Gene_Symbol, cell_line, condition) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(count),
            sd   = sd(count), .groups = "drop")

# Order cell lines
example_summary$cell_line <- factor(example_summary$cell_line,levels = c("MG63", "U2OS", "HOS"))
example_long$cell_line <- factor(example_long$cell_line,levels = c("MG63", "U2OS", "HOS"))

p_examples <- ggplot(example_summary,aes(cell_line, mean, color = condition)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.78),width = 0.72,fill = "white",linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean - sd, 0),ymax = mean + sd),
                position = position_dodge(0.78),width = 0.18,linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(data = example_long,
              aes(y = count,group = condition,color = condition),
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.10,dodge.width  = 0.78,seed = 1),
              size = 1.6,alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", mean),y = mean + sd +0.2 * max(example_summary$mean)),
            position = position_dodge(0.78),size = 2.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene_Symbol,scales = "free_y",nrow = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = COND_COLOURS,name = "Condition") +
```

```{r}
log2_mat <- counts_raw %>%
  dplyr::select(Accession, all_of(sample_cols)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Accession") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  { log2(. + 1) }

# Plot function
plot_cor_heatmap <- function(cl) {
  cols <- grep(paste0("^", cl, "_"), colnames(log2_mat), value = TRUE)
  cm   <- cor(log2_mat[, cols], method = "pearson")
  cm_df <- as.data.frame(cm) %>%
    rownames_to_column("s1") %>%
    pivot_longer(-s1, names_to = "s2", values_to = "r") %>%
    mutate(s1 = factor(s1, levels = cols),
           s2 = factor(s2, levels = cols))
  # Plot
  ggplot(cm_df, aes(s1, s2, fill = r)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", r)), size = 2) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#2166ac","#f7f7f7","#D73027"),
                         limits = c(0.5, 1), oob = scales::squish,
                         name = "Pearson r") +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s — catTFRE C1/C4/NE correlation", cl),
         x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.direction = "horizontal")
}
```

```{r eod_lod_detection}
# Detection sets per cell-line × scope, FILTERED TO TFs (Cell 2018 universe).
# A gene is "detected" if it has count >= DET_THR in AT LEAST 1 replicate.
DET_THR <- 1

detect_TF_set <- function(cl, scope) {
  cols <- if (scope == "C1+C4") {
    c(paste0(cl, "_C1_rep", 1:4), paste0(cl, "_C4_rep", 1:4))
  } else {
    paste0(cl, "_NE_rep", 1:4)
  }
  gs <- toupper(str_trim(counts_raw$Gene_Symbol))
  # ANY replicate >= DET_THR  ← was rowMeans() >= DET_THR before
  detected_any <- rowSums(counts_raw[, cols, drop = FALSE] >= DET_THR) >= 1
  unique(gs[detected_any & gs %in% tf_universe])
}

sets <- list(HOS_C1C4  = detect_TF_set("HOS",  "C1+C4"),
             MG63_C1C4 = detect_TF_set("MG63", "C1+C4"),
             U2OS_C1C4 = detect_TF_set("U2OS", "C1+C4"),
             HOS_NE    = detect_TF_set("HOS",  "NE"),
             MG63_NE   = detect_TF_set("MG63", "NE"),
             U2OS_NE   = detect_TF_set("U2OS", "NE"))

cat("TFs detected per cell-line × scope:\n"); print(sapply(sets, length))
```

```{r eod_lod_4set_helpers}
# Detection sets per cell × scope × filter
detect_set <- function(cl, scope, tf_only) {
  cols <- if (scope == "C1+C4") {
    c(paste0(cl, "_C1_rep", 1:4), paste0(cl, "_C4_rep", 1:4))
  } else {
    paste0(cl, "_NE_rep", 1:4)
  }
  gs <- toupper(str_trim(counts_raw$Gene_Symbol))
  # ANY replicate >= DET_THR  ← was rowMeans() >= DET_THR before
  detected_any <- rowSums(counts_raw[, cols, drop = FALSE] >= DET_THR) >= 1
  keep <- detected_any
  if (tf_only) keep <- keep & gs %in% tf_universe
  unique(gs[keep])
}

# 4-set Venn for one (list, scope, filter) combination
# NB: tf_only ONLY filters the cell-line detection sets.  
# EOD / LOD stay at their original size (162 / 155) regardless of `tf_only`.
plot_venn4 <- function(list_name, list_genes, scope, tf_only) {
  v <- list()
  v[[sprintf("%s\n(n=%d)", list_name, length(list_genes))]] <- list_genes
  for (cl in CELL_LINES) {
    d <- detect_set(cl, scope, tf_only)
    v[[sprintf("%s\n(n=%d)", cl, length(d))]] <- d
  }
  scope_lab  <- if (scope == "C1+C4") "C1+C4 (8 reps)" else "NE only (4 reps)"
  filter_lab <- if (tf_only) "Cells: TF-filtered (Cell 2018)" else "Cells: no filter"
  ggVennDiagram(v, label_alpha = 0, label = "count",
                edge_size = 0.4, set_size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f0f9ff", high = "darkgreen") + # orange
    labs(title = sprintf("%s — %s", filter_lab, scope_lab)) +
    theme(plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
          legend.position  = "none")
}

# ── Gene lists for EOD panels only ────────────────────────────────────────────
get_venn4_gene_lists <- function(list_name, list_genes, scope, tf_only) {
  v <- list()
  v[[list_name]] <- list_genes
  for (cl in CELL_LINES) v[[cl]] <- detect_set(cl, scope, tf_only)

  set_names <- names(v)
  combos    <- do.call(c, lapply(1:4, function(k) combn(set_names, k, simplify = FALSE)))

  rows <- lapply(combos, function(pos) {
    neg   <- setdiff(set_names, pos)
    genes <- Reduce(intersect, v[pos])
    for (n in neg) genes <- setdiff(genes, v[[n]])
    genes <- sort(genes)
    col_label <- if (length(pos) == 1) paste0(pos, "_only")
                 else paste(pos, collapse = " & ")
    tibble(region = col_label, n_genes = length(genes),
           gene_list = paste(genes, collapse = ", "))
  })

  bind_rows(rows) %>% filter(n_genes > 0) %>% arrange(desc(n_genes))
}

# EOD-only panel params (4 panels matching the 2×2 grid above)
eod_params <- tribble(~list_name, ~list_genes, ~scope,   ~tf_only,
                      "EOD",      EOD,         "C1+C4",  TRUE,
                      "EOD",      EOD,         "C1+C4",  FALSE,
                      "EOD",      EOD,         "NE",     TRUE,
                      "EOD",      EOD,         "NE",     FALSE)

eod_gene_lists <- eod_params %>%
  mutate(filter_lab = if_else(tf_only, "TF_only", "all_proteins"),
         sheet_name = sprintf("EOD_%s_%s", str_replace(scope, "\\+", ""), filter_lab),
         gene_table = pmap(list(list_name, list_genes, scope, tf_only), get_venn4_gene_lists))

# Wide format: one column per intersection region
make_wide_gene_table <- function(tbl) {
  regions     <- tbl$region
  genes_split <- lapply(tbl$gene_list, function(x) strsplit(x, ", ")[[1]])
  nmax        <- max(lengths(genes_split))
  padded      <- lapply(genes_split, function(v) c(v, rep("", nmax - length(v))))
  out         <- as.data.frame(setNames(padded, regions), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  count_row   <- as.data.frame(setNames(as.list(paste0("n=", tbl$n_genes)), regions),
                               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  rbind(count_row, out)
}

# Export: 4 sheets (one per EOD panel)
wb_eod <- createWorkbook()
hdr    <- createStyle(fontColour = "white", fgFill = "#1F4E78", textDecoration = "bold")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(eod_gene_lists))) {
  sn   <- eod_gene_lists$sheet_name[i]
  wide <- make_wide_gene_table(eod_gene_lists$gene_table[[i]])
  addWorksheet(wb_eod, sn)
  writeData(wb_eod, sn, wide, headerStyle = hdr)
  freezePane(wb_eod, sn, firstRow = TRUE, firstActiveRow = 3)
  setColWidths(wb_eod, sn, cols = 1:ncol(wide), widths = 20)
}

saveWorkbook(wb_eod,
             file.path(plots_dir, "EOD_Venn4_intersection_gene_lists.xlsx"),
             overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Per-protein, per-cell, per-condition mean count for every gene in EOD ∪ LOD
target_long <- counts_raw %>%
  mutate(gs = toupper(str_trim(Gene_Symbol))) %>%
  filter(gs %in% c(EOD_all, LOD_all)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = matches("^(HOS|MG63|U2OS)_(C1|C4|NE)_rep[1-4]$"),
               names_to = "sample", values_to = "count") %>%
  separate(sample, c("cell_line","condition","rep"),
           sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(rep        = as.integer(str_remove(rep, "rep")),
         cell_line  = factor(cell_line, levels = CELL_LINES),
         condition  = factor(condition, levels = c("NE","C4","C1")))

# Curated set of TFs that demonstrate "catTFRE recovers TFs better than NE".
SHOWCASE <- c("GTF2I","TRPS1","SP1","TEAD1","TEAD4","JUND","JUN","FOSL2")
SHOWCASE_CELL_ORDER <- c("MG63", "U2OS", "HOS")
# ============================================================================
# Pool C1 + C4 into a single 8-rep "pulldown" group
# ============================================================================
showcase_reps <- target_long %>%
  filter(Gene_Symbol %in% SHOWCASE) %>%
  mutate(scope = factor(ifelse(condition == "NE", "NE", "Pulldown\n(C1+C4)"),
                        levels = c("NE", "Pulldown\n(C1+C4)")),
         Gene_Symbol = factor(Gene_Symbol, levels = SHOWCASE),
         cell_line   = factor(as.character(cell_line),
                              levels = SHOWCASE_CELL_ORDER))
# ============================================================================
# Summary statistics
# ============================================================================
showcase_summary <- showcase_reps %>%
  group_by(Gene_Symbol, cell_line, scope) %>%
  summarise(mean_count = mean(count),
            sd_count   = sd(count),
            n_reps     = n(),
            .groups = "drop")
# ============================================================================
# Welch's t-test
# ============================================================================
showcase_pvals <- showcase_reps %>%
  group_by(Gene_Symbol, cell_line) %>%
  summarise(p = tryCatch(t.test(count[scope == "Pulldown\n(C1+C4)"],
                                count[scope == "NE"],alternative = "greater")$p.value,
                         error = function(e) NA_real_),
            .groups = "drop")
# ============================================================================
# Format p-values
# ============================================================================
format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("p = NA")
  if (p < 0.001) {return("p < 0.001")}
  paste0("p = ", signif(p, 2))
}
# ============================================================================
# Coordinates for brackets and p-values
# ============================================================================
showcase_brackets <- showcase_summary %>%
  group_by(Gene_Symbol, cell_line) %>%
  summarise(ymax = max(mean_count + sd_count, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(showcase_pvals,by = c("Gene_Symbol", "cell_line")) %>%
  mutate(label = vapply(p, format_p, character(1)),
    # positions of the two bars
    x_center = as.numeric(factor(cell_line)),
    x1 = x_center - 0.20,
    x2 = x_center + 0.20,
    # bracket heights
    y = ymax * 1.4,
    y_text = ymax * 1.5)
# ============================================================================
# Plot
# ============================================================================
SCOPE_COLOURS <- c("NE" = "#1f77b4", "Pulldown\n(C1+C4)" = "#d62728")

p_showcase <- ggplot(showcase_summary, aes(cell_line, mean_count, colour = scope)) +
  # bars
  geom_col(aes(group = scope),position = position_dodge(0.78),width = 0.72,fill = "white",linewidth = 1) +
  #geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.78),width = 0.72,color = "black",linewidth = 0.3) +
  # error bars
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_count - sd_count, 0),
                    ymax = mean_count + sd_count),
                position = position_dodge(0.78),width = 0.18,linewidth = 0.4) +
  # replicate points
  geom_jitter(data = showcase_reps,aes(y = count, group = scope),
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.18,dodge.width  = 0.78,seed = 1),
              size = 0.9,color = "black",alpha = 0.85) +
  # mean labels
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f", mean_count),
                y = mean_count + sd_count +0.04 * max(showcase_summary$mean_count +showcase_summary$sd_count,na.rm = TRUE)),
            position = position_dodge(0.78),size = 2.4) +
  # horizontal line
  geom_segment(data = showcase_brackets,
               aes(x = x1,xend = x2,y = y,yend = y),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,linewidth = 0.4) +
  # p-value text
  geom_text(data = showcase_brackets,
            aes(x = x_center,y = y_text,label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,size = 2.8,fontface = "bold") +
  # facets
  facet_wrap(~ Gene_Symbol,scales = "free_y",nrow = 2) +
  # colours
  scale_colour_manual(values = SCOPE_COLOURS, name = NULL)+
  # labels
  labs(title = "Selected EOD/LOD TFs — catTFRE pulldown (C1+C4, 8 reps) vs nuclear extract (NE, 4 reps)",
       subtitle = "Pooling C1+C4 doubles the n per pulldown bar and makes the catTFRE > NE advantage explicit",
       x = NULL,y = "Spectral count") +
  # theme
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92",color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold",size = 11),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold",size = 9),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9,color = "grey25"),
        legend.position = "right")
p_showcase
# ============================================================================
# Save
# ============================================================================
ggsave(file.path(plots_dir, "EOD_LOD_catTFRE_advantage.pdf"),p_showcase,width = 14, height = 7)
```
